title: Persistent topic queue entry
description: One line of <runs_root>/topic-queue.jsonl. Entries hold literature-grounded questions that are not yet specific enough to audit; they persist across runs so a later campaign can materialize them as derived-subproblem source records and retry them as candidates. The deterministic pipeline owns all fields; entries are append-only and transition from pending to consumed exactly once.

queue_id.description: Stable queue entry identifier assigned by the pipeline: the prefix q followed by a 16-digit lowercase hex hash.

topic_id.description: Parent topic that scopes this queued question.

statement.description: The queued question or subproblem statement, source-faithful to its supporting records.

rationale.description: Why the question is retained in the queue instead of being audited in the run that created it (for example needs_decomposition or unverifiable clarity, insufficient specificity found during research, or a lead Selection did not pick).

parent_candidate_id.description: Candidate whose decomposition produced this entry; null for retained source leads without a parent candidate.

status.description: pending: awaiting a future campaign; consumed: a later campaign replayed the entry into selection and owns its outcome from then on.
